title: Central Government's Power to Exempt Goods and Services by Notification

content.scenario: The Central Government wants to exempt certain goods and services from the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The exemption is to be made by notification.
content.outcome: The Central Government may exempt goods and services from the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, by notification, as per Section 1(4) of the Act. The exemption will be effective only if made by an express provision by the Central Government by notification.

user_queries: Can the Central Government exempt certain goods from the Consumer Protection Act?
How can the Central Government exempt services from the Act?
What is the procedure for notifying exemptions under the Consumer Protection Act?
